name: com.blacksuvmiami/miami-black-suv
title: Miami Black SUV
description: Quotes and booking requests for Miami Black SUV airport, port and city rides.

tools.name: get_service_info
tools.description: List the service types, locations, vehicle limits, add-ons and booking terms.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Quote a trip using the website fare. The hot field is an internal availability flag. fare_cents is the price the user pays. Provide flight details or acknowledge when they are unknown for an airport pickup. Some trips are request-only. Fares are subject to availability. For a typed address, the passenger enters the address on the site. For a Sprinter hourly trip, the passenger selects the duration on the site.

sprinterMode.description: Sprinter request mode. Omit for hourly.

from.description: Pickup location ID, or other for a typed address.

to.description: Drop-off location ID, or other for a typed address.

fromText.description: Pickup address when from is other.

toText.description: Drop-off address when to is other, or stops for hourly Sprinter.

date.description: Pickup date in Miami, YYYY-MM-DD. For packages use legs.

time.description: Pickup time in Miami, HH:MM in 24-hour time. For packages use legs.

hours.description: Choose a whole number of hours from 2 to 12 for Suburban hourly and 3 to 12 for Sprinter hourly.

passengers.description: Passenger count, including children. Defaults to one.

returnTrip.description: Return leg for a point-to-point round trip.

to.description: Return destination ID. Return pickup is the outbound drop-off.

date.description: Return pickup date in Miami, YYYY-MM-DD.

time.description: Return pickup time in Miami, HH:MM.

returnFlightAirline.description: Airline for the return pickup flight.

returnFlight.description: Arrival flight number for an airport return pickup.

returnFlightUnknown.description: True if the rider does not have the return pickup flight information.

flightHome.description: Departure flight number after the return drop-off.

legs.description: Pickup dates and times in the cruise package's leg order.

date.description: Leg pickup date in Miami, YYYY-MM-DD.

time.description: Leg pickup time in Miami, HH:MM.

hotelText.description: Hotel name or address for a cruise package with a hotel stop.

meetAndGreet.description: Request paid baggage-claim meet and greet for an airport pickup. Requires its flight number.

escalade.description: Request the Cadillac Escalade upgrade where offered, subject to availability.

flight.description: Arrival flight number for an airport pickup.

flightUnknown.description: True if the rider does not have the airport pickup flight information.

tools.name: create_booking
tools.description: Submit a trip the user confirmed. Return a hosted payment link for the confirmed deposit or full fare. A deposit saves the card for the automatic balance charge. Payment reserves the ride, subject to availability. Sprinter hourly and one-way are requests. For a payable trip, pass the same trip fields you sent to get_quote, plus fare_cents, stage and due_now_cents exactly as get_quote returned them.

quote_cents.description: Exact request estimate in cents the user confirmed from get_quote. Required for request_estimate trips.

fare_cents.description: Exact fare in cents the user confirmed from get_quote. Required for payable trips. Use the fare_cents value from get_quote.

stage.description: Payment stage the user confirmed from get_quote. Required for payable trips. Use the stage value from get_quote.

due_now_cents.description: Exact amount due now in cents the user confirmed. Required for payable trips. Use the due_now_cents value from get_quote.

name.description: Passenger name confirmed by the user.

email.description: Booking email provided and confirmed by the user.

phone.description: Booking phone number with country code where applicable.

notes.description: Trip notes the user wants to pass to Miami Black SUV.

lang.description: Language for booking email copy. Defaults to en.

idempotency_key.description: Generate one random value of 16 to 64 characters per booking. Reuse that exact value on any retry the tool permits. Use a new value for a separate booking.

user_confirmed.description: True only after the user approved the trip, price and amount due if quoted, contact information, and booking contact disclosure.
